{"type":"thought","data":" of roughly 0.7 tokens"}

{"type":"thought","data":" 42.6%, making the market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" price of 0.435 slightly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" overpriced for Yes "}
{"type":"thought","data":"and a small positive"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value for No. The Bet365"}
{"type":"thought","data":" consensus gives a fair"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probability closer "}
{"type":"thought","data":"to 44%, which tilts "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the expected value toward"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Yes again."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe consensus average"}
{"type":"thought","data":" from oddsrun puts fair"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probability at roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 42.8% for Riestra and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 57.2% for Unión. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" market price of 0.435"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is essentially fair,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" so the expected value"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is negligible either way.\n\nThe key question is whether to pick "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the outcome with the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" highest probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of winning or the highest"}
{"type":"thought","data":" expected value. No "}
{"type":"thought","data":"carries about a 56% "}
{"type":"thought","data":"chance of winning, while"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Yes carries only about"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 43%. In prediction "}
{"type":"thought","data":"markets, the higher-probability"}

{"type":"thought","data":" more often but pays"}
{"type":"thought","data":" less."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nMy record is -219 "}

{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nI will shade slightly"}

{"type":"thought","data":"percent."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nA 40% true probability"}

{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe agent record is"}
